fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $40,000, nonrefundable and due at signing of Franchise Agreement. In 2025, fees charged ranged from $0 to $40,000. Discounts and waivers available: (1) Franchise Option Program — fee refunded in exchange for a 4% increase in Continuing Royalty rate for the initial 10-year term; (2) Military/First Responder Program — 20% reduction for eligible active/honorably discharged U.S. Armed Forces members, police officers, firefighters, or paramedics/EMTs on first Franchised Business; (3) Multi-Unit Program — 25% reduction on Initial Franchise Fee for second and additional Franchises when purchasing 3 or more in a single transaction; (4) Hard to Serve/Underserved Markets — up to 10% discount; (5) Conversion Franchise Program — Initial Franchise Fee fully waived for qualified conversion franchisees with at least 12 months of plumbing services history and over $250,000 in prior-12-month sales. Franchisor may also offer financing of up to the full amount of the fee. All discounts/waivers granted at franchisor's sole discretion.
raw_excerpt:
You will pay us an initial franchise fee of $40,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee"). The Initial Franchise Fee is deemed fully earned at the time it is due. It is due at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement. It is nonrefundable except as discussed below. We may offer to prospects who meet our qualifications, including creditworthiness, financing of up to the full amount of the Initial Franchise Fee. See Item 10 for additional information.
In 2025, we charged an Initial Franchise Fee that ranged from $0 to $40,000.
